lines.cap: The world's most feared secret society got exposed, because one member couldn't keep his stuff in his drawers.
lines.say: The world's most feared secret society got exposed, because one member couldn't keep his stuff in his drawers.

lines.cap: May 1776. Bavaria. A law professor named Adam Weishaupt starts a secret club. The Illuminati.
lines.say: May 1776. Bavaria. A law professor named Adam Weishaupt starts a secret club. The Illuminati.

lines.cap: Everyone gets a code name. His was Spartacus. The plan: put enlightened men into power, quietly.
lines.say: Everyone gets a code name. His was Spartacus. The plan: put enlightened men into power, quietly.

lines.cap: It works. Around two thousand members. Nobles, officials, reportedly even the poet Goethe.
lines.say: It works. Around two thousand members. Nobles, officials, reportedly even the poet Goethe.

lines.cap: Then in 1785, the ruler of Bavaria bans all secret societies. And police raid a member's house.
lines.say: Then in 1785, the ruler of Bavaria bans all secret societies. And police raid a member's house.

lines.cap: In his drawers, piles of secret papers. The government prints them for everyone to read. By 1787, the Illuminati is dead.
lines.say: In his drawers, piles of secret papers. The government prints them for everyone to read. By 1787, the Illuminati is dead.

lines.cap: But the eye on the pyramid? Not theirs. That's America's Great Seal. Weishaupt never even saw it.
lines.say: But the eye on the pyramid? Not theirs. That's America's Great Seal. Weishaupt never even saw it.

lines.cap: Two hundred and fifty years later, a club that lasted nine years is blamed for everything. Wars, banks, pop stars.
lines.say: Two hundred and fifty years later, a club that lasted nine years is blamed for everything. Wars, banks, pop stars.
